articles.summary: At least 12 people are being treated for anthrax after eating infected meat from wildlife carcasses.

articles.title: Canada's inflation holds firm at 3% in August as travel, shelter costs rise
articles.summary: Canada's annual inflation rate held firm at three per cent in August, Statistics Canada said Monday, as gasoline prices and food costs eased slightly last month, while prices for tours and travel rose.

articles.title: N.L. spent $1.1M on forensic audit of travel nurse agency payments, findings remain off limits to public
articles.summary: Newfoundland and Labrador health officials are keeping details of an external forensic audit of payments made to a travel nursing agency under wraps — at least for now.
